blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Не следует множить сущее без ___ (необходимость).
exercises.prompt: Entities should not be multiplied without necessity.
exercises.why: «без» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This wood has a beautiful grain.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
exercises.why: «для» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
